bootstrap_rule: WP0/G1 may validate source identity, JSON shape, historical observer determinism and B0 counts without depending on not-yet-built v0.2 Constitution schemas. WP1 introduces the first v0.2 contracts/schemas; later gates must use those authoritative validators.

validators.mechanism: historical schema/topology runtime + canonical payload hashes

forbidden_bootstrap_shortcuts: invent v0.2 schema results before schemas exist
treat scanner heuristics as constitutional authority
treat current warning count as B0
wp1_transition: Replace bootstrap-only record-shape checks with the materialised v0.2 schema/registry validator surface before G2.
